verdict.rationale: TrueLayer documents registrable outbound webhooks: each Console app sets a webhook URI, and the Payments API v3 sends JSON notifications to it for events such as payment status changes. Requests are signed with Tl-Signature, and official open-source signing libraries are provided for verification. Limits: only one webhook URI per app, registration is evidenced only through Console, and per-event subscription filtering is not shown. missing for 10: per-event-type subscription selection, programmatic (API) webhook registration, multiple endpoints per app, independent/hands-on corroboration.
